node_dimensions: provided outer boxes, including label padding; may enlarge, not shrink
label_wrapping: wrap within given box using declared deterministic character-width estimate; no browser font metrics required
arrows: end on target boundary, start on source boundary; self-loops explicitly routed
parallel_edges: distinct lanes or visibly separate curves/polyline offsets; preserve all IDs
old_layout: run v1 first, pass its coordinate JSON as input to v2; no precomputed answer layout supplied
update_report: displacement per unchanged node and causes for necessary relocation
verification: use exactly rendered node/label boxes and edge polylines; intersections with unrelated nodes are failures; edge crossings allowed but identified; label overlaps diagnosed with IDs
